summary: Attempted to reproduce user bug: 'Meeting-attached document doesn't appear in Documents tab.' BUG NOT REPRODUCED. The document appears in the Documents library in all three phases (in-memory before save, after save, and after hard refresh). POST /api/files/upload -> 200; PUT /api/content -> 200; no console errors. Backend /api/content confirms the new doc is persisted with category 'Meetings' and description 'Attached to meeting: <meeting name>'.
action_items: No fix needed for the reported bug — feature works end-to-end. If the user still sees this: ask them for repro steps and whether they clicked Save. Note that toggling edit-mode OFF via 'Done' when NOT dirty triggers a reload() that would discard unsaved in-memory changes (Layout.jsx toggleEdit lines 47-50). Consider warning admins if they toggle off edit mode with unsaved changes.
critical_code_review_comments: Meetings.jsx MeetingAttachments.onFile uses closed-over `content.documents` and `attachments` snapshots when calling update() twice in the same tick. Currently works because React batches setContent calls and each call's `prev` reflects the previous update. However, this is fragile — a safer pattern is to accept a functional updater in ContentContext.update (e.g., update(path, fn) similar to setContent(prev => ...)) or to build both updates from a single cloneDeep in one call. Recommend refactor for robustness against future concurrent updates.
Layout.jsx toggleEdit — when editMode is on and not dirty, it calls reload() which will silently wipe any staged (non-dirty-tracked) changes. Not currently harmful but risky.
Documents page uses inputs in edit mode without visible titles above them; automated tools that key on inner_text won't see doc names (edge case for testing, not a user bug).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a small text file (test_meeting_attach.txt / probe) to the first upcoming meeting. Backend now contains 8 documents including 'test_meeting_attach.txt' (category: Meetings, description: 'Attached to meeting: SAMPLE — 2027 Summer Business Meeting'). Also a leftover 'CURL Meeting Doc' from prior tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified end-to-end that uploading a meeting document DOES add it to Documents in CHECK1 (no save, count 8->9, filename found in innerHTML), CHECK2 (after save, count persists, PUT /content 200), and CHECK3 (hard reload of /documents shows the doc from GET /content). IMPORTANT: When inspecting the Documents page in edit mode, the doc TITLE lives in an <input value=...>, so use document.body.innerHTML or read input.value — do NOT rely on inner_text(). Backend responses verified via page.evaluate(fetch('/api/content')).
rca of the issue: The reported bug could not be reproduced. Possible cause of the user's original complaint: (a) They toggled edit mode off without hitting Save (Layout.toggleEdit reloads content when editMode is on and not dirty — though on this build dirty is true after upload so it would auto-save; still, a race is possible). (b) They had a filter/category selected on /documents that excluded 'Meetings'. (c) They confused expected behavior — the toast explicitly says 'Remember to Save'; without saving, a hard refresh would remove the doc. Recommend: (1) verify from user which of these scenarios occurred; (2) add a persistence indicator or warning banner if navigating away with unsaved changes on Documents/Meetings; (3) auto-scroll or highlight newly added doc on the Documents page for discoverability. Reproduction steps executed: login admin -> /meetings -> toggle edit -> upload file to first upcoming meeting -> navigate to /documents via sidebar (CHECK1 PASS) -> return, click Save (200) -> navigate to /documents (CHECK2 PASS) -> hard reload /documents (CHECK3 PASS).
